operations.description: Add a card. From the agent it is a PROPOSAL: it waits in Proposed until the person accepts it (at most 20 a day).

labels.description: JSON list of label names or ids, e.g. ["Bug"]

assignee.description: Assign it (the person only): you, agent or none

reason.description: The agent: why you propose it

due.description: Due date, or empty to clear

operations.name: cards.comment
operations.description: Comment on a card (markdown).

operations.name: review.list

operations.description: The person: send the work back to the agent with what to change; it goes back to the column it was worked in.

reason.description: What to change (the agent reads it)

operations.name: review.reject
operations.description: The person: reject the work; the card comes back to you.
